from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows] + [grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols]
    sep = Counter(sep_colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rblocks=[]; start=0
    for r in [x for x in sep_rows if grid[x][0] == sep] + [h]:
        if start < r: rblocks.append((start,r))
        start=r+1
    cblocks=[]; start=0
    for c in [x for x in sep_cols if grid[0][x] == sep] + [w]:
        if start < c: cblocks.append((start,c))
        start=c+1
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[bg if sum(grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != sep for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)) == 1 else 1
             for c0,c1 in cblocks] for r0,r1 in rblocks]
